description: The tree of the content cards of a layout (docs/spec/exposure.md#window-snapshot). Each case gives the lines and the cards of a stored space layout, {xs, ys, cards}, with xs and ys the line positions as fractions of the plane and each card spanning the lines c0 to c1 and r0 to r1; a card whose id is a window side (left, right, top, bottom) is a place card and is outside the tree. root is the tree that the page and the workbench of the mygo host derive: a split is {direction, size, children} and a card is {card, size}; frame and tabs of a card are not part of a case, because they depend on the plane size and the tab data. A region is a row when a vertical line crosses it from edge to edge, else a column; size values are compared within a relative 1e-9.

cases.name: single card beside a window sidebar
grid whose two lines cross the whole window is a row of two columns
grid of three columns whose lines all cross the whole window
nested column whose top holds a row
